Love the videos, love the destinations, jokes and info and most of all the authenticity of anyone featured!! Never feels like a watered down, commercialised travel show. Always feels like we're getting a genuine experience along with you Show less Read more Like 12 Dislike Reply @cathiechangeslanes 1 year ago Hey Josh, great tips!! I have a really important one. Locals are very happy to answer your questions, but please before you ask anything, say “good morning”, good afternoon”, etc. It may seem silly to a statesider, but it is an important custom and a way of showing respect to the V.I. culture. Thanks!! Show less Read more Like 9 Dislike Reply @rhondaz356 1 year ago (edited) You ALWAYS nail what we need to know. NOBODY does it better, Josh. Show less Read more Like 6 Dislike Reply @mariawasnick5472 1 year ago Exactly what happened to us with the ferry: we got double-charged. It can be tricky and a bit chaotic to get on the ferry, but in the end it all worked just fine. I think you did right, Josh, by not booking the ticket in advance. It might be easier. Great video!
